name: Kumarakom Lake Resort
summary: Kumarakom Lake Resort is a heritage resort on 25 acres beside Vembanad Lake at Kumarakom. Its Ayurveda spa is Ayurmana, and guests can stay in lakeside villas or on its houseboats.
highlights: 25 acres on the banks of Vembanad Lake
Ettukettu restaurant in a traditional eight-sided building
A short boat ride from Kumarakom Bird Sanctuary
